notes.title: Announcement of a Second Release Delay for “Darugarami Haigorei”
notes.content: [p]We had planned to release [b]“Darugarami Haigorei”[/b] in September, but due to unexpected development issues we must [b]postpone the release once again, now targeting October[/b].[/p][p]We sincerely apologize to everyone who has been looking forward to the game for the inconvenience and concern caused by these repeated delays.[/p][p]Thank you very much for your understanding and support.[/p]

notes.title: Announcement of the Postponement of the Release of “Darugarami Haigorei”
notes.content: [p]I had planned to release [i]Darugarami Haigorei[/i] in August, but as a solo developer, I’ve run into some delays in development. As a result, I’m truly sorry to say that the release date will be postponed to September.[/p][p]I deeply apologize to everyone who has been looking forward to the game for the inconvenience and worry this may cause.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your understanding and patience.[/p]
